name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a complete Qiskit program demonstr
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a complete Qiskit program demonstrating the effect of depolarizing noise (p1=0.0068, p2=0.0247) on a GHZ state using AerSimulator and a custom NoiseModel. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
